notes: v132 makes the Cold Glue brush-channel planner the single brush-motion authority. Cold Glue remains center-tack only: bottles pre-spin before first brush contact, hold the brush-facing angle for every inside/outside parallel overlap, and only consume remaining center-out wipe rotation after one brush side opens. The turn ratio is calculated from the available one-sided opening length and physical machine direction. The v128/v131 and earlier center-out/left-right brush wrappers are retired.
